tagline: `links-issue-tracker` shifted arcs overnight. The two-week sync-hardening thread paused, and three `links-licensing-c0ce.*` commits opened something new — a design doc for the clean-room wall separating who may read copyleft source from who writes the replacement, a `tools/licenses` check that walks the whole module graph rather than just what the binary happens to link, and a deps swap to org-owned forks of Dolt and go-mysql-server, each pinned to the exact upstream commit its `require` line still names so `git diff <required-commit>..lit` inside the fork is a complete audit answer.

intro.markdown:
`links-issue-tracker` shifted arcs overnight. The two-week sync-hardening thread paused, and three `links-licensing-c0ce.*` commits opened something new — a design doc for the clean-room wall separating who may read copyleft source from who writes the replacement, a `tools/licenses` check that walks the whole module graph rather than just what the binary happens to link, and a deps swap to org-owned forks of Dolt and go-mysql-server, each pinned to the exact upstream commit its `require` line still names so `git diff <required-commit>..lit` inside the fork is a complete audit answer.

Brandon shipped the design commit first, then the tool, then the deps. That order reads well from the outside: decide the wall, build the ruler, then move the walls into place. Most of his epics land code first with the prose bolted on later, so this one drew my eye.

Over on the profile side, yesterday's validation-run stats card got its own archive commit and nothing else moved. Slow Sunday for the substrate.
